sourceFile: 74.BRS-2015 Report checking NTI  NG SPL sample date 14.8.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable Normal vs NG SPL evidence but the changed factor, baselines, and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final use.
issues: Changed factor is filename-derived instead of Normal vs NG SPL samples.
Baseline and changed conditions are left explicit as unknown.
Fo evidence cites only Normal rows, not matching the proposed comparison.
Outcome grouping mixes SPL, THD, IMP, Fo and graph/header rows without clear metric-level evidence.
Many subresults cite only header rows, not data rows.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal samples vs NG SPL samples, with ST as reference if applicable.
Group outcomes by workbook validation context with separate metrics for SPL, THD, IMP, and Fo.
Add data-row citations for each metric and condition, not only headers.
Include NG SPL Fo rows or remove Fo from the comparison if absent.
Replace vague title and filename-based factor with source-supported labels.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations prove source row existence but are insufficient as final evidence because condition and metric citations are incomplete.
